pages.purpose: Primary user authentication gate. Supports Google Sign-In, redirect after auth, and demo access.

pages.purpose: First-time post-login role decision screen (Seeker vs Flat Owner).

pages.title: Seeker Onboarding | NestMate
pages.purpose: Full-funnel seeker profile creation: intent, avatar, age, gender, profession, city, up to 3 localities, rent budget, move-in timeline, and 10-point lifestyle quiz.

pages.title: Owner Onboarding | NestMate
pages.purpose: Flat owner property profile setup: flat type, city, locality, rent, deposit, furnishing, house rules, amenities, and owner quiz.

pages.title: Explore Rooms and Roommates | NestMate
pages.purpose: Core discovery marketplace featuring 6 tabs (Rooms, Roommates, PG & Coliving, Saved, My Connections, All Listings), city selector, search, filters modal, and card feeds.
Individual room listing details, image gallery, rent breakdown, amenities, house rules, compatibility rating, owner profile snippet, contact modal, and share actions.
Seeker public roommate profile details, lifestyle match matrix breakdown, traits tags, compatibility percentage, send connection request, and block/report actions.
Seeker dashboard containing feed tabs (top matches, explore rooms, my connections, saved rooms, saved profiles), completeness bar, and quick actions.
Comprehensive owner command center: overview metrics, Recharts weekly view trends, listing status toggles (active/paused/closed), applicant ranking & screening, and seeker discovery.
Full-featured multi-step wizard for property owners to publish a new room or flat listing with image uploads, amenities, pricing, rules, and screening questionnaire.
Property update interface allowing owners to modify room details, pricing, vacancy status, and uploaded photos.
In-app real-time messaging hub between matched seekers or tenants and owners. Includes message read receipts, phone number exchange trigger, and contact card.
User's own profile view showing verification tier, completeness meter, lifestyle summary, listing status (for owners), and links to edit profile & settings.
Profile editing form for bio, age, profession, budget, target areas, lifestyle preferences, and avatar updates.
Adjust compatibility questionnaire answers, sleep schedule, smoking, drinking, dietary preferences, and target matching rules.
Side-by-side comparison tool for property owners to evaluate multiple applicants across compatibility score, cleanliness, smoking, and income/profession.
Account settings, notification toggles, privacy preferences, deactivate account, and sign-out controls.
Activity feed showing connection requests, message alerts, listing view milestones, and system notices with mark-as-read controls.
Interactive Leaflet map showing geo-located listings across Bangalore/selected cities with price markers and detail slide-overs.

pages.purpose: Safety tips for seekers and owners, in-person visit checklists, safe payment guidelines, and emergency reporting procedures.

pages.purpose: FAQ accordion, searchable knowledge base, contact support ticket form, and feedback submission.

pages.purpose: Step-by-step product walkthrough explaining profile setup, quiz matching, connection requests, and move-in.

pages.title: About Us | NestMate
pages.purpose: Founding mission, team vision, cities supported, and platform principles.

pages.purpose: Legal disclosure regarding user personal data, Aadhaar masking, phone number masking, cookies, and deletion rights.

pages.purpose: Breakdown of Free tier vs NestMate Pro plans with feature comparison and subscription perks.
404 error page with link returning user to home or marketplace.
Development-only database seeding console for generating realistic Indian profiles, apartments, and clearing test data.
Master admin overview displaying aggregate platform metrics, user counts, listing counts, pending verification count, and open report flags.
User management console with search, role filters, account suspension, deactivation, and verification status toggles.
Listing moderation console allowing admins to review, approve, feature, pause, or remove property listings.
Identity document audit queue for reviewing owner electricity bills, Aadhaar submissions, and DigiLocker certificates with approve/reject actions.
Trust & Safety triage queue handling reported users, fraudulent listings, abusive messages, and spam flags.
Broadcast announcement composer to send system-wide notifications to all seekers, all owners, or specific users.
Marketplace health analytics: city coverage, active vs stale listing ratio, supply-demand balance by locality.
Admin access control (manage admin emails), demo data purge, and factory reset / nuclear database wipe function.
